newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to issue index-linked bonds in April - finmin.
newsitem.headline: Greece to issue index-linked bonds in April - finmin.

text.p: Greece's finance ministry will either issue or auction CPI index-linked bonds with maturities exceeding 5.0 years in April instead of end February as iniitally planned, Deputy Finance Minister Nicos Christodoulakis told reporters.

The likely maturity range of the indexed bonds was 7.0 to 10 years but the ministry had yet to make up its mind whether it would use the American or the Swedish valuation systems, said Christodoulakis.

Cash flows are indexed to inflation for the life of the bond according to the American system as opposed to the indexation of the principal amount at maturity under the Swedish, he said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
